subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should shared reply-session self-heal be the canonical recovery, with Discord using its replay-release contract only if shared recovery still fails?
rationale: The open shared-session PR and this Discord PR recover the same conflict at different layers; choosing the owner determines the aggregate retry budget, latency, dedupe behavior, and exact-once guarantees.

options.title: Shared heal then replay
options.body: Use shared self-heal as the canonical recovery and convert any remaining pre-dispatch conflict into DiscordRetryableInboundError so transport redelivery remains possible.

options.title: Discord replay only
options.body: Leave shared initialization unchanged and make Discord release or reschedule the inbound event after its local retry budget exhausts.

options.title: Layer fixed budgets
options.body: Retain both recovery loops but specify and test the combined retry count, latency, abort, history, and dedupe semantics.

recommendation.title: Shared heal then replay
recommendation.body: Use shared self-heal as the canonical recovery and convert any remaining pre-dispatch conflict into DiscordRetryableInboundError so transport redelivery remains possible.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal spans both the Discord processing path and shared session lifecycle where this cross-layer policy must be decided.
